info.title: WH40k Colony Manager API
info.description: REST API for managing Warhammer 40k Rogue Trader colonies

post.description:
Register a new user account.

This endpoint is public and does not require authentication.

Password Requirements:
- Minimum 8 characters (configurable)
- At least one uppercase letter
- At least one lowercase letter
- At least one number
- At least one special character

Authenticate user and return JWT tokens.

This endpoint is public and does not require authentication.

Refresh access token using refresh token.

This endpoint is public and does not require authentication.

Security: Implements refresh token rotation - old refresh token is
invalidated when a new one is issued. If an old token is reused,
all sessions for that user should be invalidated (future enhancement).

get.description: Get current authenticated user information.

schema.title: Response Change Password Api V1 Auth Change Password Post

get.description: List all colonies with summary information.

schema.title: Response List Colonies Api V1 Colonies Get

get.description: Get a colony by ID.
Get computed state for a colony.
List all modifiers for a colony.

schema.title: Response List Colony Modifiers Api V1 Colonies  Colony Id  Modifiers Get

post.description: Add a modifier to a colony.

delete.description: Remove a modifier from a colony.

get.description:
Get the roll status for a colony.

Returns information about when the next event and development rolls are due.
Event rolls occur every 60 days, development rolls every 90 days.

post.description:
Create a new event for a colony.

Events are GM-created occurrences that affect colony stats.
Requires colony_manager role or higher.

get.description: Get all events for a colony.

schema.title: Response Get Events By Colony Api V1 Events Colonies  Colony Id  Get

get.description: Get an event by ID.

patch.description: Update an event. Requires colony_manager role or higher.

delete.description: Delete (soft delete) an event. Requires colony_manager role or higher.

post.description:
Create a new development plan for a colony.

Development plans track long-term colony development goals.
Requires colony_manager role or higher.

get.description: Get all development plans for a colony.

schema.title: Response Get Development Plans By Colony Api V1 Development Plans Colonies  Colony Id  Get

get.description: Get a development plan by ID.

patch.description: Update a development plan. Requires colony_manager role or higher.

delete.description: Delete a development plan. Requires colony_manager role or higher.

get.description:
Get audit logs for a colony.

Returns a chronological history of changes made to the colony.
Requires colony_manager role or higher.

schema.title: Response Get Audit Logs By Colony Api V1 Audit Logs Colonies  Colony Id  Get

get.description:
Get a specific audit log entry by ID.

Requires colony_manager role or higher.
Get all members of a colony.

schema.title: Response Get Colony Members Api V1 Colonies  Colony Id  Members Get

post.description:
Add a user to a colony.

Requires appropriate permissions (typically owner or editor role).

get.description: Get a specific user's membership in a colony.

patch.description:
Update a member's role in the colony.

Requires appropriate permissions (typically owner role).

delete.description:
Remove a user from a colony.

Requires appropriate permissions (typically owner role).

get.description:
Export a colony and all its related data to a JSON file.

Requires edit permission in the colony. Returns a JSON file with:
- Colony base data and modifiers
- Representative (if assigned)
- All events
- All development plans
- All colony users

The exported file can be imported later to restore the colony state.

post.description:
Import a colony from a previously exported JSON file.

The JSON content should be provided in the request body.
Creates a new colony with all related data (representative, events, development plans, users).

Returns the ID of the newly created colony.

schema.title: Response Import Colony Api V1 Colonies Import Post

get.description:
Stream real-time notifications via Server-Sent Events.

Connect to this endpoint to receive a stream of notifications about:
- Colony changes
- Event creation/updates/deletion
- Development plan changes
- Colony user changes

The connection will remain open and push notifications as they occur.
Clients should implement automatic reconnection logic.
List all infrastructure for a colony.

schema.title: Response List Infrastructure Api V1 Colonies  Colony Id  Infrastructure Get

post.description: Add new infrastructure to a colony.

get.description: Get a specific infrastructure by ID.
List all representatives.

schema.title: Response List Representatives Api V1 Representatives Get

get.description: Get a representative by ID.

post.description: Assign a representative to a colony.
Unassign a representative from their colony.

get.description: List all modifiers across all colonies.

schema.title: Response List All Modifiers Api V1 Modifiers Get

get.description: Get a specific modifier by ID (searches across all colonies).
List all planetary resources for a colony.

schema.title: Response List Resources Api V1 Colonies  Colony Id  Resources Get

post.description: Add a new planetary resource to a colony.

get.description: Get a specific planetary resource by ID.

patch.description: Update a planetary resource's abundance or notes.

delete.description: Remove a planetary resource from a colony.

get.description: List all support upgrades for a colony.

schema.title: Response List Upgrades Api V1 Colonies  Colony Id  Upgrades Get

post.description: Add new support upgrade to a colony.

get.description: Get a specific support upgrade by ID.

delete.description: Remove support upgrade from a colony.
